text: Given a Recorder stub for scripts/local/1 and POST scripts/run, When immybot_scripts_run(scriptId=1, computerId=1, confirm=true) is called, Then the outbound request body has a top-level body key (not script) containing the script record, and the tool returns done: true with the stubbed output.
evidence: uv run pytest -q tests/test_api_client.py -k script_run -> 3 passed, 43 deselected (2026-10-29). Test asserts 'script' not in sent, sent['body']['action'] == SCRIPT['action'], and result['output'] == {'output': 'removed 12 files'}.

text: Given SOP 263, computer DEV-W11-01 (computerId=1), stored Local script 1, When an agent calls immybot_scripts_run(scriptId=1, computerId=1, confirm=true) against the live mspbotsai.immy.bot instance, Then the call does not return HTTP 400 and the output contains TEST-VPN-OK DEV-W11-01.
steps: Obtain ImmyBot credentials for the mspbotsai.immy.bot instance (tenant 1) used in the ticket
Call immybot_scripts_run with scriptId=1, computerId=1, databaseType=Local, runAs=System, timeout=90, confirm=true
expect: No HTTP 400 for a missing body field or an invalid cancellationId; result contains done: true and output includes TEST-VPN-OK DEV-W11-01
evidence: needs a real vendor account (mcp-track.md 2.5/3): DEV01 has no mspbotsai.immy.bot credentials in this environment; does not block 6b per mcp-track.md 3 completion criteria

text: Given the same Recorder stub as TC1, When immybot_scripts_run is called first with confirm omitted and then with confirm=true, Then neither the preview dict nor the final result contains the script's action text (only id/name/computer/status/output fields).
evidence: Same run as TC1. Test asserts SCRIPT['action'] (the real PowerShell source, 'Remove-Item $env:TEMP\\* -Recurse') not in json.dumps(preview) and not in json.dumps(result).

text: Given a Recorder stub for scripts/global/<id> (local lookup 404s) and POST scripts/run, When immybot_scripts_run(scriptId=<id>, computerId=<n>, confirm=true, databaseType=Global) is called, Then the request succeeds the same way as the Local case in TC1.
evidence: uv run pytest -q tests/test_api_client.py -k script_run -> 3 passed (2026-10-29). New test stubs scripts/local/31 as 404 and scripts/global/31 as the script record; asserts sent['body']['databaseType'] == 'Global', cancellationId is a valid UUID, result['done'] is True.

text: Given any valid call with confirm=true, When the outbound request is inspected, Then sent["cancellationId"] parses as a valid UUID and is not of the form mcp-<id>-<id>.
evidence: Same run as TC1. Test asserts uuid.UUID(sent['cancellationId']) does not raise and sent['cancellationId'] != 'mcp-31-7'.

text: Given two back-to-back confirmed calls with the same scriptId/computerId, When both outbound requests are inspected, Then their cancellationId values differ.
evidence: uv run pytest -q tests/test_api_client.py -k script_run -> 3 passed (2026-10-29). New test calls immybot_scripts_run twice with the same scriptId=31/computerId=7 and asserts both cancellationId values are valid UUIDs and differ from each other.

text: Given the tool's registered description (as returned by tools/list), When it is read, Then it states that immybot_scripts_get is optional for a script id already approved by an administrator or a pre-reviewed workflow, while the confirm: true requirement remains stated.
steps: Start the server locally (or inspect the docstring of immybot_scripts_run in src/immybot_mcp/tools/scripts.py)
Call tools/list and read the description for immybot_scripts_run
expect: Description still requires confirm: true, and additionally states immybot_scripts_get is optional for an already-approved script id
evidence:
2026-10-29: started `uv run python -m immybot_mcp` locally, called POST /mcp tools/list with placeholder ImmyBot headers. Response tool count = 68 (matches README 'Tool count (68)'). immybot_scripts_run.description = "Run a saved script on one computer now and return its output. Needs confirm: true.

        Executes code on the endpoint. Only when the user explicitly asks; review the script first with
        immybot_scripts_get. Reviewing first is optional when the script id was already approved by an
        administrator or a pre-reviewed workflow.
        " -- confirm: true requirement unchanged, new optional-review sentence present. Raw response saved at /tmp/tools_list_full.out (not committed, scratch evidence).

Call immybot_scripts_run with that scriptId, a valid computerId, confirm=true

evidence: needs a real vendor account (mcp-track.md 2.5/3): DEV01 has no mspbotsai.immy.bot credentials in this environment; does not block 6b per mcp-track.md 3 completion criteria. Global-path request shape itself is covered automatically by TC4.
